answer_1.quote: We generate a dataset of fill-in-the-blank style questions designed to reveal biases between brand references and the attributes they are associated with.
answer_1.outputs: LLMs generate attribute or brand selections to fill blanks in prompts, based on stimuli or attributes provided.

answer_2.quote: We use Kendall's τ test results for Experiment 1. We use a significance level of α < 0.05 to reject the null hypothesis...

answer_4.quote: We employ a human-LLM partnership to gather attributes, and all stimuli are collected and crossverified by human annotators.
answer_4.guideline: An attribute was retained if it was deemed suitable by at least three annotators.
